findings.body: An interrupted first worker attempt can leave a recorded conversation that this collector misses after a retry. In src/forge/codex.py:192–194, recovery clears the pending turn without logging its conversation; lines 156–157 then select a fresh conversation because no turn started, and line 311 overwrites the previous ID. This collector therefore archives only the replacement conversation, leaving the earlier recorded one active. Preserve every created conversation ID independently of turn completion. Extend tests/test_merge_command.py:306 to retry the worker with a different conversation before closing and merging, and assert that both conversations are archived.
findings.title: Not done: 5. Archive every recorded Codex conversation
